items.title: CommandLM: Data driven behavior level descriptor for ego vehicles
items.topic: CommandLM: Data driven behavior level descriptor for ego vehicles
items.summary: The CommandLM model, developed by a research group, generates human-readable behavior descriptions for ego vehicles using fused multi-sensor data. Trained on the CommandLM-nuScenes dataset, CommandLM achieves CIDEr 0.67 and BERT-F1 0.88, making it suitable for planner supervision and safety auditing in autonomous driving systems.

items.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration with the Common-Sense Reasoning Capabilities of LLMs for Autonomous Driving
items.topic: Multi-Agent Orchestration with the Common-Sense Reasoning Capabilities of LLMs for Autonomous Driving
items.summary: A hybrid framework for autonomous driving, proposed by researchers, integrates PPO-trained reinforcement learning, PID control, and LLM common-sense reasoning. The system uses an orchestrator to coordinate these components, enhancing robust perception and decision-making in diverse and unseen scenarios.

items.title: CARA: Concept-Aware Risk Attention for Interpretable Collision Anticipation
items.topic: CARA: Concept-Aware Risk Attention for Interpretable Collision Anticipation
items.summary: CARA, a concept-aware risk attention framework, provides interpretable collision anticipation in autonomous driving. It derives risk concepts from accident narratives, aligns them with video frames, and organizes them into evolving concept trajectories, offering explicit risk evidence.
